text: I decided to get braces here because of the service from the staff and the lovely doctor. Everyone at this clinic is so nice. They also have a wide selection of colored rubber bands to choose from.

It has become my regular clinic.
1. Location: Clean, air-conditioned, not many people. It is a small shophouse but the interior of the clinic is beautifully decorated. If you go during a festival, there might be snacks to give away.

2. Price: Compared to other clinics outside, it is very cheap and not expensive at all. Dental scaling does not cost more than 1,200-1,300 depending on the amount in the mouth. Those who have social security can claim it without having to pay in advance.

3. Service: The service at the counter is good, polite, and explains details clearly. The admin answers questions on the page very quickly. You can make an appointment via chat.

4. Dental work: The doctor is very kind, polite, not fierce, patient, and can consult if you have any questions. It is fast. It takes less than 15 minutes to get dental scaling and 20-30 minutes to fill the tooth. He gives very good advice and is very skilled and has a gentle hand.

5. Travel: The disadvantage is that there is no parking in front of the shop. Those who drive a car will have a hard time finding a parking spot. Motorbikes can be parked on the sidewalk in front of the shop. I recommend coming by MRT or public transportation. There are buses passing by and it is close to Bang Son MRT. Get off at this station and walk for about 3-5 minutes.
